voiceover: Jesus had just healed a man on the Sabbath, and the religious leaders were furious. So he said something staggering. The Father, he said, has handed all judgment to the Son — so that all may honor the Son, just as they honor the Father. Not honor like the Father's. Honor identical to it. For a Jew raised on the Shema, that lands like a thunderclap — because that honor — that glory — belongs to God alone. The LORD says, my glory I give to no other. And Jesus doesn't soften it: whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent him. You cannot honor God while refusing the Son. And heaven agrees. In Revelation, every creature sings the same honor to the One on the throne and to the Lamb. In that very same book, an angel refuses worship — worship God! — yet the Lamb receives what the angel forbids. This is the H in the HANDS of Christ's deity: Honors, Attributes, Names, Deeds, Seat. And so, by the Father's own design, the Son receives the very honor due to God himself.
